t0021-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0021-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0021-02.gloss: Unmarked test-plot samples are stored beside household supplies.
t0021-02.rival_reading: An emergency crew could have stored ordinary pest-control samples there while clearing the house; bad labels do not show a program malfunction.
